title: Cosmic Portal Rat
description: A black rat stands on a mossy stone in the foreground, gazing upward at a glowing turquoise portal arch filled with a swirling cosmic vortex, a red planet, and white roots. To the right, a hooded grim reaper figure with glowing yellow eyes holds a staff beside a melting blue ghost, while small boats, playing cards, and lily pads float in dark water below under a starry sky with swirling galaxies.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a black rat standing on a moss-covered stone looking up at a large ornate turquoise archway that opens into a swirling cosmic portal with stars, a red planet, and hanging white roots. A hooded grim reaper with glowing yellow eyes stands beside a dripping melting blue ghost. Dark water with lily pads, small paper boats, and floating playing cards in the foreground. Vibrant swirling galaxies and icy formations in the background, intricate linework with dripping paint effects.
